The match was played on 23 April 2022 at the [[Estadio de La Cartuja]] in [[Seville]] between [[Real Betis]] and [[Valencia CF|Valencia]].{{cite web|url=https://en.as.com/en/2020/02/05/football/1580911629_748235.html|title=Official: La Cartuja stadium in Seville to host Copa del Rey finals until 2023|website=as.com|publisher=AS|date=5 February 2020|access-date=2 March 2022|archive-date=12 April 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210412184505/https://en.as.com/en/2020/02/05/football/1580911629_748235.html|url-status=dead}}{{Cite web|url=https://www.worldfootball.net/competition/ro118187/md0/results-and-standings/|title=Copa del Rey 2021/2022 Final|website=World Football|date=2 March 2022|access-date=2 March 2022}} Real Betis won 5–4 on penalties following a 1–1 draw after [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] for their third Copa del Rey title.{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/61202911|title=Real Betis win Copa del Rey after beating Valencia on penalties|website=BBC Sport|date=23 April 2022|access-date=23 April 2022}}{{cite web |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2022/apr/24/real-betis-valencia-copa-del-rey-final-match-report |title=Joaquín joy as Real Betis beat Valencia on penalties to lift Copa del Rey|first=Sid|last=Lowe|work=The Guardian|date=23 April 2022|access-date=23 April 2022}} ==Background== [[Alaska (singer)|Alaska]] and [[Mario Vaquerizo]] delivered a musical performance before the game.{{Cite web|url=https://es.noticias.yahoo.com/reacci%C3%B3n-un%C3%A1nime-actuaci%C3%B3n-mario-vaquerizo-202955357.html|website=[[yahoo.com]]|title=Reacción unánime a la actuación de Mario Vaquerizo y Alaska en la Copa del Rey|date=22 April 2022}} ==Route to the final== {{further|2021–22 Copa del Rey}} {| style="width:100%;
